<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bodoni+Moda:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..96,400..900;1,6..96,400..600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ─────────────────────────── tokens ─────────────────────────── */
:root{
  --ink:#0a090b; --case-hi:#2a2019; --case:#181310; --case-lo:#0e0b09;
  --edge:#3d2e21; --ivory:#f8f3e6; --dim:#9c917c; --mute:#7c6b54;
  --brass:#c99a3f; --brass-hi:#f0d18a; --brass-lo:#7d5a1e;
  --copper:#c07a42; --felt:#9d2a3c; --felt-dk:#5d1220;
  --level:0;
  --kh:clamp(148px,21vh,212px);
  --disp:'Bodoni Moda','Didot','Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;
  --body:'IBM Plex Sans',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --mono:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Menlo,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0; min-height:100vh; overflow-x:hidden; color:#e9e1d1;
  font-family:var(--body); font-weight:300; letter-spacing:.01em;
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 118%, rgba(201,154,63,.13), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(90% 55% at 50% -6%, rgba(150,110,64,.14), transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(#0b0a0d 0%, #141017 46%, #0a090b 100%);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
/* ─────────────────────────── ambience ─────────────────────────── */
.room{position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0}
.pool{
  position:absolute; left:50%; top:58%; width:min(1400px,150vw); height:min(900px,110vh);
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(1 + var(--level)*.10));
  background:radial-gradient(50% 46% at 50% 50%, rgba(233,186,96,.17), rgba(233,186,96,.05) 42%, transparent 72%);
  opacity:calc(.55 + var(--level)*.75);
  transition:transform .10s linear, opacity .10s linear;
  animation:breathe 11s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes breathe{0%,100%{filter:blur(0px)}50%{filter:blur(6px)}}
.grain{
  position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:.05; mix-blend-mode:soft-light;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='160' height='160'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3'/></filter><rect width='160' height='160' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
  background-size:160px;
}
.mote{position:absolute; width:2px; height:2px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,224,168,.5);
  filter:blur(.4px); animation:drift linear infinite}
@keyframes drift{0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0);opacity:0}12%{opacity:.55}88%{opacity:.4}100%{transform:translate3d(38px,-160px,0);opacity:0}}
.wrap{position:relative; z-index:1; width:min(1220px,94vw); margin:clamp(18px,4vh,52px) auto 0; padding-bottom:64px}
/* ─────────────────────────── fallboard ─────────────────────────── */
.fallboard{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:28px; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:22px clamp(18px,3vw,30px) 20px; border:1px solid var(--edge); border-radius:12px 12px 5px 5px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(91deg, rgba(0,0,0,.22) 0 2px, transparent 2px 6px),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#2b211a,#191310 58%,#100c0a);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,222,170,.10), inset 0 -22px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 22px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
}
.mark{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px}
.logo{
  font-family:var(--disp); font-weight:500; font-style:italic;
  font-size:clamp(38px,6.4vw,68px); line-height:.9; letter-spacing:.005em;
  background:linear-gradient(96deg,#f6e2b0 6%,#c99a3f 38%,#8d6a29 58%,#f2d489 84%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.75)) drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(201,154,63,.18));
}
.sub{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.3em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--mute)}
.tagline{margin:12px 0 0; max-width:44ch; font-size:14px; line-height:1.65; color:#a2937f}
.tagline kbd{margin:0 1px}
kbd{
  font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10.5px; font-weight:500; color:#e7d5ac;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a221a,#171310); border:1px solid #46372a;
  border-bottom-width:2px; border-radius:4px; padding:1px 5px; white-space:nowrap;
}
.lid-right{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; align-items:flex-end; min-width:280px; flex:1 1 320px}
#scope{width:100%; height:52px; display:block; border:1px solid #33281e; border-radius:5px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0b0a,#151010); box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.gauges{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px 20px; margin:0; width:100%; justify-content:flex-end}
.gauges>div{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px}
.gauges dt{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:.22em; color:var(--mute); text-transform:uppercase}
.gauges dd{margin:0; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:var(--brass-hi)}
.bar{display:inline-block; width:66px; height:6px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.09); overflow:hidden; vertical-align:middle}
.bar i{display:block; height:100%; width:0%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--brass-lo),var(--brass-hi)); transition:width .09s linear}
.vu{position:relative; width:100%; height:5px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); overflow:hidden}
.vu i{position:absolute; inset:0 auto 0 0; width:0%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6f8f4a,var(--brass) 62%,#d9534f); transition:width .06s linear}
.vu span{position:absolute; top:-2px; width:2px; height:9px; background:#fff3d6; left:0; opacity:.8; box-shadow:0 0 6px #fff}
.led{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9px; letter-spacing:.2em; color:var(--mute); text-transform:uppercase}
.led b{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#4a2c14; box-shadow:inset 0 0 3px #000; transition:.3s}
.led.on b{background:#7fd66a; box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(127,214,106,.75)}
/* ─────────────────────────── the instrument ─────────────────────────── */
.piano{
  margin-top:16px; border:1px solid var(--edge); border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#241b15,#15100c 40%,#0c0908);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,224,176,.10), 0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
.plate-shell{position:relative; margin:0 10px; height:clamp(180px,25vh,286px); border-radius:8px 8px 0 0; overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}
#plate{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block}
.chips{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden}
.chip{position:absolute; bottom:8px; transform:translateX(-50%); white-space:nowrap;
  font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--brass-hi);
  background:rgba(18,12,8,.72); border:1px solid rgba(201,154,63,.45); border-radius:20px; padding:2px 8px;
  animation:chipUp 1.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) forwards}
@keyframes chipUp{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,12px) scale(.86)}18%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-72px) scale(1.03)}}
.plate-tag{position:absolute; top:9px; left:12px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:.24em;
  color:rgba(240,209,138,.42); text-transform:uppercase}
.capo{margin:0 10px; height:6px; border-radius:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6dfa6,#c99a3f 42%,#6f5019 78%,#3a2a10);
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 0 24px rgba(201,154,63,calc(.1 + var(--level)*.4))}
.felt{margin:0 10px; height:11px;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#b13145,#8b2032 55%,#4f0f1a);
  box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.keybed{padding:0 10px 12px; perspective:1200px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0a08,#070605)}
.keys{--ww:5%; position:relative; display:flex; height:var(--kh); touch-action:none; user-select:none}
.wk{
  position:relative; flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; height:100%; border-radius:0 0 7px 7px; cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdf7 0%,#fbf5e8 58%,#f0e8d6 84%,#d8cdb5 100%);
  box-shadow:inset -2px 0 3px rgba(120,98,64,.22), inset 1px 0 0 #fffef9,
    inset 0 -12px 12px rgba(150,128,92,.16), 0 4px 0 #b3a78d, 0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  transform-origin:50% 0; transition:transform .055s ease, box-shadow .08s ease, filter .16s ease;
}
.wk:hover{filter:brightness(1.03)}
.wk.on{transform:translateY(5px) rotateX(2.4deg); filter:brightness(.9) saturate(.92);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fdf6e4,#f2e6cd 60%,#d6c8ab);
  box-shadow:inset 0 6px 14px rgba(120,90,50,.28), inset -2px 0 3px rgba(120,98,64,.2), 0 1px 0 #9c8f74}
.bk{
  position:absolute; top:0; height:63%; z-index:4; cursor:pointer; border-radius:0 0 5px 5px;
  width:calc(var(--ww) * .60); left:calc((var(--i) + 1) * var(--ww) - var(--ww) * .30);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3b3b44 0%,#1b1b21 34%,#0c0c10 74%,#25252d 100%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.24), inset 0 -6px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.6),
    -2px 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 2px 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 7px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
  transform-origin:50% 0; transition:transform .055s ease, filter .14s ease;
}
.bk:hover{filter:brightness(1.25)}
.bk.on{transform:translateY(4px) rotateX(2deg); filter:brightness(1.6) saturate(1.2)}
.lbl,.caplbl{position:absolute; left:0; right:0; text-align:center; pointer-events:none; opacity:0; transition:opacity .25s}
.lbl{bottom:11px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:9.5px; color:#8f8267; letter-spacing:.02em}
.caplbl{bottom:28px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; font-weight:600; color:var(--brass-lo)}
.bk .lbl{bottom:7px; font-size:8px; color:#b6a888}
.bk .caplbl{bottom:21px; color:var(--brass-hi)}
body.labels .lbl,body.labels .caplbl{opacity:1}
.bk .lbl,.bk .caplbl{opacity:0}
body.labels .bk .lbl,body.labels .bk .caplbl{opacity:.92}
.dot{position:absolute; bottom:46px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%;

.wk.gin .dot{background:rgba(120,96,50,.55)}
.bk.gin .dot{background:var(--brass-hi); box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(240,209,138,.6)}

.bk.gout{filter:brightness(.55)}

(function(){

const MODES={
  major:{label:'Ionian · major',steps:[0,2,4,5,7,9,11]},
  minor:{label:'Aeolian · minor',steps:[0,2,3,5,7,8,10]},
  dorian:{label:'Dorian',steps:[0,2,3,5,7,9,10]},
  mixo:{label:'Mixolydian',steps:[0,2,4,5,7,9,10]},
  lydian:{label:'Lydian',steps:[0,2,4,6,7,9,11]},
  harm:{label:'Harmonic minor',steps:[0,2,3,5,7,8,11]},
  pent:{label:'Major pentatonic',steps:[0,2,4,7,9]},
  blues:{label:'Blues',steps:[0,3,5,6,7,10]}
};
const ROOMS={studio:[1.1,2.6],hall:[2.7,2.1],plate:[1.9,3.4],cathedral:[4.4,1.7]};

/* ══════════════════════════ state ══════════════════════════ */
const state={low:36,span:4,volume:.85,tone:.62,reverb:.32,room:'hall',labels:true,guided:false,
  root:0,mode:'major',sustain:false,seventh:false};
const MAXPOLY=18;

/* ══════════════════════════ audio engine ══════════════════════════ */
let ctx=null,bus={},voices=new Map(),NOISE=null,td=null,fd=null;
function makeIR(dur,decay){
  const rate=ctx.sampleRate,len=Math.max(1,(dur*rate)|0),buf=ctx.createBuffer(2,len,rate);
  const pre=(0.018*rate)|0;
  for(let c=0;c<2;c++){
    const d=buf.getChannelData(c);let lp=0;
    for(let i=0;i<len;i++){
      const t=i/len;
      let v=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-t,decay);
      lp+=(v-lp)*0.42;                 // darken the tail
      d[i]= i<pre ? 0 : lp*Math.min(1,(i-pre)/(0.01*rate));
      if(c&&i%97===0) d[i]*=0.9;       // slight decorrelation
    }

}
function initAudio(){
  if(ctx) return;
  const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(!AC) return;

  bus.comp.attack.value=.005; bus.comp.release.value=.24;
  bus.an=ctx.createAnalyser(); bus.an.fftSize=2048; bus.an.smoothingTimeConstant=.82;

  bus.voice.connect(bus.tone).connect(bus.master);
  bus.master.connect(bus.comp); bus.master.connect(bus.send);

  bus.comp.connect(bus.an).connect(ctx.destination);

  const n=(0.12*ctx.sampleRate)|0; NOISE=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate);

const AMP=[1,.48,.28,.18,.12,.08,.055,.038];

  if(!V||V.dead) return; V.dead=true;

function noteOff(m,src){
  const s=heldBy.get(m); if(s){s.delete(src); if(!s.size) heldBy.delete(m);}

}
